definitions.supplemental: Cf. (?) Welsh traf stir, strain ; trafu to stir, agitate.

quotations.old_english: Eallum ðe deópe and ful treaflíce teónan þolian

source_text: treaflíce; adv. Grievously, painfully :-- Eallum ðe deópe and ful treaflíce teónan þolian omnibus injuriam patientibus, Ps. Th. 102, 6. [Cf. (?) Welsh traf stir, strain ; trafu to stir, agitate.]
